title: ARIRANG World Tour European Leg Wraps in Paris With Record Attendance
detail: BTS closes the European leg of the ARIRANG World Tour with two nights at Stade de France in Paris (July 17-18), drawing roughly 92,000 fans per show — the highest single-show attendance of any BTS concert to date. Across the leg's five cities — Madrid, Brussels, London, Munich, and Paris — the group performed 10 shows to a combined 717,000-720,000 fans. The tour delivered a string of firsts for a Korean act: BTS became the first Korean artist to headline Brussels' King Baudouin Stadium and Munich's Allianz Arena, and their two nights at London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium were the highest-attended shows in that venue's history. Tickets across the leg sold out in under 45 minutes in every city, with London clearing in roughly 30 minutes.

media.caption: BTS wraps the European leg of the ARIRANG World Tour with a record 92,000-fan finale at Paris's Stade de France.
